description: Edit a benchmark's test definition or scoring configuration. Requires owner and a plan with benchmarks; no model run. Only supplied fields change, but sample_params and schema_gen_params replace their parameter objects wholesale. The judge may be replaced, not cleared; scenario_type is immutable. Changed test definitions make previous results stale. Re-run affected models to refresh their scores. See enricher://docs/model-benchmark.
